description: This source file defines the LargePdfFiles class, which contains a method to test handling of large PDF files by creating, saving, loading, and re-saving a large document using PdfSharp library functions.

classes.name: LargePdfFiles
classes.description: A class containing a method to perform large PDF file processing and testing, including creation, saving, loading, and re-saving.

methods.name: LargePdfFileTest
methods.description: Performs a test by generating a large PDF document with 150,000 pages, timing the process of creation, saving, loading, and re-saving, and logging the elapsed times.
